description:
Hello to everyone who has spent years looking for a truly deep electronics tycoon.

Maybe you always wanted a game where you could actually design processors and graphics cards, build your own architectures, and run a company like Intel, AMD, Nvidia, or Apple.

I wanted that too.

But almost every game I found had some kind of painful compromise. Some reduced chip design to a few basic sliders and a single performance number. Others had scripted markets that barely reacted to what you created.

So I started making the game I wanted to play myself.

Here you can design your own CPUs and GPUs, configure their architecture, and build the actual chip layout. But creating the chip is only the beginning.

Your processor continues to exist inside the game world. A laptop manufacturer may decide to use it in a new device. If the cooling system is too weak, the chip may overheat and throttle under load. Its performance will depend on the games, programs, operating systems, and workloads it is used for.

The market reacts to all of this.

Journalists may criticize your new processor for being too expensive or barely faster than the previous generation. Customers may love its efficiency, hate its software support, or simply decide that your competitor offers a better deal. A technically impressive chip does not automatically become a successful product.

Hardware also needs software.

You can develop your own instruction set architecture and operating system. You will need to improve multithreading, browser performance, software compatibility, and online services. Designing the best piece of silicon is only half the job. Building an ecosystem around it is where things become really difficult.

The game also includes semiconductor factories, process node development, and many AI-controlled competitors with different strategies and personalities.

I will not pretend that every system already works perfectly. The game is still growing and many parts of it are being improved. But these systems are already here, they interact with each other, and the game is becoming closer to the electronics tycoon I spent years trying to find.

Maybe it is the game you were looking for too.
whats_new: Fixed campaign saves and recovery, CPU chiplet conversion and cache accounting. Improved OS release guidance.

description:
Drop a coin, watch the pile tip over, and hear it all come pouring down. Coin Coin is a cozy idle coin pusher set on a pixel island run by cats.

There is no timer to beat and no forced ads. Play for a minute, or leave it running and just watch the coins stack up.

HOW IT PLAYS

• Tap to drop coins onto the pusher and tip the pile over the edge

• Slide the net to catch everything that falls

• Coins that slip off the sides are not lost: your cat crew hauls them back at the Salvage Dock

• Fire skills like Tower, Shower and Large Coin when the board needs a push

WHAT YOU BUILD

• Two pixel islands that grow from an empty beach into a finished town, with 50 builds and an ending

• A crew of 30 cats to recruit, level up and station at the dock

• Upgrades for coin value, speed and bonuses, crafted from the material coins you collect

• 25 Google Play Games achievements and cloud save

IDLE, THE RELAXED WAY

• Your crew keeps earning while the game is closed. Collect it when you come back

• Playable offline (rewarded ads, purchases and cloud save need a connection)

• Ads are optional. You only watch one when you choose a reward

Made for players who like arcade coin pushers and coin dozers, medal games, idle and incremental games, pixel art, and cats.

GOOD TO KNOW

Coin Coin is a casual idle game intended for players aged 13 and older. USDT in this game is a virtual in-game currency, not real USDT tokens or cryptocurrency. It cannot be withdrawn or exchanged for cash or cryptocurrency and does not provide real financial returns. The game includes ads and optional in-app purchases.

Indian Cars Driving 3D Online is an open world Indian car driving game. Drive Indian SUVs across India, get out and walk as Arjun or Meera, escape the police, do nitro kickflips, play car football and race real players online.

★ FEATURES

• Open world India: highways, toll plazas, Mumbai city and famous landmarks

• Get out of the car: walk, run and jump as Arjun or Meera

• Police chase with wanted stars

• Nitro, kickflip and drift with white tyre smoke

• Car football, Survivor arena, Mega Ramp and Stunt Arena

• Online multiplayer races, or offline against AI drivers

• In-game phone with chat and camera

• Indian SUVs and supercars with paint and upgrades

• Day and night, rain and fog

WHAT YOU DO IN THE GAME

Open world free roam

You start in a large open world map of India and simply drive. There is no timer and no mission you have to accept. Traffic moves around you, roads connect towns and highways, and you can stop anywhere. Landmarks such as the Statue of Unity, the Golden Temple, Rumi Darwaza, Mysore Palace, Connaught Place and Lal Qila appear along the route.

Thirteen city tracks

Outside the open world there are thirteen race tracks built around Indian cities: Delhi, Mumbai, Jaipur, Lucknow, Varanasi, Mysore, Chennai, Gujarat, Amritsar, Kota, Bangalore, Nainital and Manali.

Online multiplayer

Races can be played against real people in real time. Drive up to a race gate in the open world and other players in your session can join the same race. With no network connection, the same races can be played offline against computer-controlled drivers.

Four race modes

Race is a sprint to the finish line. Drift scores you on how long you can hold a slide. Time Attack asks you to beat a target time. Elimination removes the last car at set intervals until one is left.

Cars and upgrades

Indian SUVs, hatchbacks and supercars are unlocked as you progress. Change paint and body parts, and upgrade engine, handling and acceleration.

Controls

Tilt steering, an on-screen steering wheel, or tap-to-steer buttons. Switch any time in the settings menu.

The game runs on regular Android phones and you can start driving straight away without creating an account.

Indian Cars Driving 3D Online is free to play and contains ads.

Made in Kota, India by Ansh Jain Global Networks Private Limited.

Your stream earns gold even while you sleep, with up to 8 hours of offline income banked for you.

Come back and collect the whole pile at once.

In a hurry? Tap your player to fast-forward the stream. It's an idle game, but your thumbs still get a say.

▶ Eight leagues, from the PC bang to the world stage

Rookie, Amateur, Trainee, Semi-Pro, Pro, the international cup, and finally world champion.

Every promotion triples how strong your opponents are.

From the Semi-Pro Circuit onward, points give way to a real season, and only the top two teams reach a best-of-five final.

New training unlocks with every league you climb. Repeat a drill enough to break a mastery tier and its payout doubles.

Upgrade eight gear slots — mouse, keyboard, monitor, headset, chair, desk, PC, and lighting —

then hire an analyst, a physical trainer, and a manager to compound your growth.

▶ Scout your roster

Five seats to fill: Top, Jungle, Mid, ADC, Support.

Four rarities from common to legend, and every teammate favors a different stat.

Start the ones whose synergy matches yours and watch your team power jump.

▶ Watch every match in pixels

Kills, Watchtower secured, Power Station captured, Gate destroyed — the whole match plays out live in pixel art.

When it ends you get a scoreboard with per-teammate KDA. Stack up wins, earn points, get promoted.

▶ Retire, then reboot

Win it all and you can close the career and start again from nothing.

Every promotion and title you earned converts into legend badges,

and the perks you buy with them stay with you — this run, the next one, and every one after.

Your second career is far faster than your first.

▶ Short sessions, no pressure

Seven daily missions, a 7-day attendance streak, and a 30-level season pass.

A match costs 10 energy, and energy refills at 1 per minute.

Two matches on the commute and one collection before bed is plenty.

· You want an idle game that never nags you with notifications

· Watching numbers go up makes your day

· You have a weakness for pixel art

· You love a climb that starts at the very bottom

description:
Real Driving: Vehicle & Park is made for players who want to drive at their own pace while still having clear goals to complete. It focuses on vehicle handling in everyday road situations, so the experience can feel calm during open driving and more demanding when control matters. As a result, players who search for a car driving simulator can use this page to understand the game before they download Real Driving: Vehicle & Park.


Main Driving Features

Driving physics with vehicle weight

Real Driving: Vehicle & Park uses driving physics that consider acceleration, turning, braking, tire grip, cargo weight, and crash effects. This means a small vehicle, a truck, and a trailer do not feel the same when you steer or slow down. Because vehicle weight affects control, players need to adjust speed before corners and handle braking with care.

Different vehicles to unlock and customize

You can drive several vehicle types, including sports cars, SUVs, trucks, heavy duty trucks, and giant trailers. After moving through the game, you can unlock more vehicles and change their look. In addition, the game includes styling choices, cabin decorations, and dashboard ornaments, so each ride can feel more personal without changing the main driving goal.

Parking missions for careful control

Real Driving: Vehicle & Park includes precision parking tasks for players who want more structured challenges. These missions focus on reverse parking, narrow spaces, and careful movement around obstacles. Hard Mode adds more pressure because trailer control and tight turning require slower steering and better timing.

Free Roam, Stunt Mode, and varied roads

You can also spend time outside parking missions through Free Roam and Stunt Mode. The game includes city roads, mountains, off road trails, countryside routes, and industrial areas. Since each area changes the way you drive, exploration gives players a reason to try different vehicles instead of repeating the same route.

Relaxed truck cruising without racing pressure

Real Driving: Vehicle & Park is not only about completing difficult parking tasks. You can also choose slower truck cruising when you want a calmer session. This gives casual players room to drive, turn, and explore without needing to race against other vehicles or chase high speed results.


Who Real Driving: Vehicle & Park Is For

Real Driving: Vehicle & Park fits players who enjoy both open driving and vehicle control challenges. If you prefer quiet sessions, Free Roam and truck cruising provide a slower way to play. If you want tasks that test skill, parking missions and Hard Mode give clearer goals that depend on steering, braking, and trailer handling.


Before Playing Real Driving: Vehicle & Park

The game is useful to consider if you like a Vehicle 3D Driving Simulator with several driving styles in one place. It does not focus only on racing, so the main appeal comes from controlling different vehicles in different spaces. Players who know this before installing can choose between casual exploration and more precise driving challenges based on their mood.


How to Play Real Driving: Vehicle & Park on Android

Real Driving: Vehicle & Park starts with basic driving actions, then gives you room to explore vehicles, modes, and parking tasks. After installing the Real Driving: Vehicle & Park APK, follow the in game flow and begin with simple driving before moving to harder challenges.

  1. Open the game and choose an available vehicle, then spend a short time learning how it accelerates, turns, and brakes.
  2. Start with a calmer driving mode, such as cruising or Free Roam, so you can understand road layout and vehicle response.
  3. When you feel comfortable, enter parking missions and use slower movements to line up the vehicle before turning into the target space.
  4. Try larger vehicles, trucks, and trailers after learning the basics, because heavier vehicles need more space and earlier braking.
  5. Use customization options when available, then return to city roads, mountains, off road trails, or stunt areas to test the vehicle in new situations.


Get Started with Real Driving: Vehicle & Park

Real Driving: Vehicle & Park offers 3D driving, parking missions, free exploration, and vehicle customization in one Android game. description:
Turn the key, feel the starter catch, and bring an engine to its redline. Revving is an engine simulator you drive: every sound it makes is computed live from the physics of the engine turning in front of you. No recordings, no loops.

REAL PHYSICS, REAL SOUND

• Every engine is simulated in real time: pistons, connecting rods, crankshaft, cams and valves, gas flowing through intake and exhaust, fuel burning in each cylinder.

• The sound is synthesized from the simulated exhaust pulses, so it changes with everything you do: throttle, load, gear, rpm, the rev limiter cutting in, VTEC crossing over.

• Each engine drives what it really drove, car, motorcycle, aircraft or locomotive, with its gearing, weight, aerodynamics, redline, rev limiter and top speed.

DRIVE IT YOURSELF

• Swipe the ignition key to switch on and hold it to crank until the engine fires.

• Three pedals, clutch, brake and gas, each worked by its own finger. Slide up for more; pressure-sensitive screens feel how hard you press.

• Drag the H-pattern lever through the gate. Forget the clutch and the gears grind.

• Stall it, bog it, bounce it off the limiter, launch it: the engine answers like the real one.

• Gamepads work too: triggers for gas and brake, the right stick for the lever, the D-pad to shift.

WATCH IT RUN

• The engine is drawn in 3D, turning in step with what you hear: pistons, crank, cams, valve springs, headers.

• Hold a finger on any part to see its name.

• Coded colors show the intake and exhaust flow at a glance.

• A driving-game HUD: rev counter with shift lights, a speedometer scaled to the car, live charts of manifold pressure, air flow and air/fuel ratio, plus VTEC and limiter lamps.

• Tap the stage for the full gauge cluster, with a firing lamp for every cylinder.

19 ENGINES, EVERY LAYOUT, EACH IN WHAT IT DROVE

• Honda B18C5 inline-4: VTEC to 8,400 rpm, in an Integra Type R (free)

• Chevrolet 454 big-block V8: 7.4 liters, in a 1978 C20 pickup (free)

• Subaru EJ25 flat-4: the boxer rumble, in an Impreza WRX STI

• Harley-Davidson Shovelhead V-twin: the potato-potato idle, in an Electra Glide

• Audi inline-5: the five-cylinder warble, in a Coupe quattro 20V

• Toyota 2JZ inline-6: the smooth straight six, in a Supra

• GM LS V8: in a C5 Corvette

• Ferrari F136 V8: the flat-plane scream to 9,000 rpm, in a 458 Italia

• Lexus LFA V10: 9,000 rpm and one of the great exhaust notes

• Ferrari 412 T2 V12: a 1995 Formula 1 engine that revs to 17,000 rpm

• Radial 5 and Radial 9: aero engines on a propeller

• Ariel Square Four: two twins geared together, in the 1950s motorcycle

• Volkswagen VR6: six cylinders in one narrow head, in a Golf VR6

• Volkswagen W12: two VR6 banks on one crankshaft, in a Phaeton

• BRM H16: two flat-eights geared together, in the 1966 P83 Formula 1 car

• Rolls-Royce Vulture X24: four banks of six, on an Avro Manchester's propeller

• Junkers Jumo 205: an opposed-piston two-stroke diesel aero engine

• Napier Deltic: eighteen cylinders in a triangle, as in the British Rail Class 55

FREE TO START

The Honda B18C5 and the Chevrolet 454 are free. One purchase unlocks the other seventeen, for good.

A GARAGE TO CHOOSE FROM

Every engine turns on its own turntable in the selector, with its layout, displacement, valves, redline and gears. Tap one to drive it; switch any time.

SETTINGS

• Audio quality from Low to Ultra: more detail in the simulation for more detail in the sound, as far as your phone allows. A load meter shows how hard it works.

• Graphics from Low to High, with worn metal, shadows and smooth edges at the top.

• 75 languages, and metric or imperial units.

• Manual, up/down or automatic gearbox.

Low-latency audio, landscape play, no internet needed. Headphones recommended.

Engine simulation ported from Engine Simulator by Ange Yaghi (AngeTheGreat), MIT license.

All product names, logos and brands are the property of their respective owners. Revving is not affiliated with or endorsed by any of the manufacturers named.

Block Craft 3D: Realm Builder is made for players who want a calm building game on Android without strict missions or forced progress. It gives you a block world where the main goal is to create, adjust, and grow a space in your own way. Because the game focuses on free play, you can spend short sessions shaping an idea or longer sessions working on bigger projects. The Block Craft 3D: Realm Builder APK is suitable for users looking for simple construction play.


Main features of Block Craft 3D: Realm Builder

Free building at your own pace

Block Craft 3D: Realm Builder centers on creative sandbox gameplay, so you can place blocks and shape your surroundings without following a fixed path. You decide what to build first, where to expand, and how much detail to add. This makes the game easy to approach for players who prefer open play instead of task based progress.

Create a personal realm

You can build a realm from simple structures to larger designs as your ideas grow. A small house can turn into a wider settlement, while towers, castles, streets, or open spaces can be added over time. Since the realm is personal, the game leaves room for testing layouts, changing shapes, and rebuilding parts that no longer fit your plan.

Explore an open block world

Block Craft 3D: Realm Builder also gives you a large world made for movement, building, and discovery. As you look around, you can find new places that may suit different construction ideas. This open space helps players who like to plan by walking through the area first, then choosing a location that matches the structure they want to create.

Collect materials and craft blocks

You collect materials as part of the building process, then use them to craft new blocks for more construction choices. This adds a steady rhythm to the game, because building and gathering support each other. As your realm grows, crafted blocks give you more ways to change the look, shape, and scale of your projects.

Simple controls for casual play

You control the game through clear Android touch actions, which makes it easier to start building without a long learning process. Movement, block placement, and basic interaction are designed for quick use on a phone screen. As a result, Block Craft 3D: Realm Builder works well for short relaxed sessions as well as longer building time.


What to know before choosing Block Craft 3D: Realm Builder

Block Craft 3D: Realm Builder is mainly focused on creative building, crafting, and open exploration. It does not present itself as a mission driven game, so users who want constant goals, story stages, or combat focused play may find the pace slower. However, players who enjoy making their own plans can use the game as a quiet space for construction and design.

The game is also a better fit for users who want to build their own realm rather than follow preset structures. Since the provided information focuses on personal building, resource collection, and block crafting, users should not expect unconfirmed features such as multiplayer visits, pets, or shared city systems. This distinction is useful for anyone comparing similar names in the Block Craft 3D search results.


How to play Block Craft 3D: Realm Builder on Android

After you download Block Craft 3D: Realm Builder, start with a small plan so the first building session feels clear. The game works best when you explore the area, gather what you need, and build in stages instead of trying to finish a large realm all at once.

  1. Open Block Craft 3D: Realm Builder on your Android phone and enter the block world. Take a moment to move around the nearby area, because the first location often shapes the style of your early build.

  2. Choose a simple starting spot for your realm, such as a flat area for a house or a higher space for a tower. Once the place feels suitable, begin placing blocks to outline the basic shape.

  3. Collect materials from the world as you continue building. These materials help you craft more blocks, so gathering during early play gives you more options when your structure becomes larger.

  4. Use crafted blocks to add walls, floors, paths, roofs, or other parts of your design. If a section does not look right, adjust it step by step instead of rebuilding the entire structure.

  5. Expand the realm when the first build is stable. You can add nearby buildings, reshape the terrain, or connect areas with paths so the space grows in a clear direction.


Get started with your realm

Block Craft 3D: Realm Builder offers a relaxed Android building experience based on open space, block crafting, and personal design. description:
Win power at the ballot box. Defend your city on the front line.

PresidentOnline: GO – Governing Orders is a president simulator and politics strategy game that brings elections, war and strategy together in one online world. On one side, power under the lights; on the other, shadows waiting in the dark to seize it… Offices, parties and armies are run by players, and every move you make shifts the balance of power on the map.

◆ POLITICS: POWER COMES FROM THE BALLOT BOX

• Join a party or found your own; rise through congresses and win your candidacy in the primaries.

• Compete for Game President, Assembly President, Economy President, Intelligence Chief and Game General.

• Become a deputy in the 81-seat Assembly and have your say in law, tax and governance votes.

• Forge party alliances, grow your vote weight and beat your rivals in two-round elections.

• Guard your office: a president who loses trust faces recall and coups.

◆ WAR: CITIES ARE WON ON THE FRONT LINE

• Settle in one of 60 ancient cities, from Athens to Sparta, from Troy to Rome, and make it grow.

• Train 29 land, air and naval unit types in your barracks, hangar and naval yard.

• Watch wars unfold on the battlefield in 10-minute rounds on land and sea fronts.

• Set your formation with front line, flanks, artillery and air cover; raise your walls.

• Occupy cities, blockade ports and win back a fallen city with a liberation war.

• Build your own militia; move it to your city, send it to other cities and back your side in wars.

◆ STRATEGY: EVERY MOVE SHAPES THE NEXT

• Formation beats numbers: an empty flank leaves your front line exposed.

• Form defensive alliances between cities so your allies' garrisons join your defense.

• Become Intelligence Chief and gather intel on rival armies with spy reports.

• The enemy's reserves stay hidden: weigh the risk and pick your timing.

• Become your city's decider: choose a Democratic, Semi-Democratic or One-Man government and appoint the governor.

• General points earned in war boost your party in the Game General race, and serving as a city's Governor or Warden adds weight to your vote.

◆ ECONOMY AND MEDIA: THE FUEL OF POWER

• Build your economy with BaşkanCash and BaşkanGold; grow your wealth through jobs, shops, trade, BaşkanBank and the crypto market.

• Balance your city treasury, shop income and army upkeep; unpaid troops desert.

• Post on the media feed, make statements, steer public opinion with interviews and follow war news as it happens.

• Join the community in global chat, party chats and polls.

The PresidentOnline legacy enters a new era. This time, you decide who is shadow and who is real.

All cities, parties, offices, wars and events in the game are fictional and have no connection to real persons, institutions or states. The game requires an internet connection and offers optional in-app purchases.

Cozy Farm - Idle & Chill is an idle farming game where you plant and harvest crops to grow a farm of your own.

Your farm keeps growing while the app is closed, and hired workers handle planting and harvesting for you.

No combat, no competition — just a farm quietly growing at its own pace.

This is an idle game, so time passes and income accumulates even after you close it.

Come back later and collect everything that piled up while you were away.

■ Workers do the work for you

Hire workers and planting and harvesting happen automatically, with no tapping needed.

The more workers you hire, the less you touch and the faster the farm runs.

■ Endless upgrades

Level up crops, growth speed, and income step by step to expand your farm.

Each upgrade unlocks the next one, so the progression never stalls.

■ A cozy farm of your own

Watch crops grow and get harvested, and shape the farm into a place that feels like yours.

Simple controls make it an easy, relaxing casual game.

■ Playable without spending

The download and gameplay are free, and the game includes in-app purchases.

You can grow crops, hire workers, and buy upgrades without ever paying.

In-app purchases only speed things up, and there are no paid randomised draws.

■ Good for you if

· You like games you check in on briefly and often

· You want to relax without combat or competition

· You enjoy watching numbers grow

■ Frequently asked questions

Q. What kind of game is Cozy Farm?

A. An idle farm management game where harvest income upgrades your farm and workers.

Q. Does it progress while closed?

A. Yes. The farm keeps running and offline income accumulates while the app is closed.

Q. What are workers?

A. Hired helpers that plant and harvest for you automatically.

Q. Do I need to pay?

A. No. You can progress without spending; in-app purchases are optional.

Q. Are there gacha or loot boxes?

A. No. The game has no paid randomised draws.

Q. What ages is it for?

A. All ages. There is no combat and no suggestive content — you plant and harvest crops.

description:
Pop Epoch is for players who want a strategy game that moves quickly from early survival to a developed society. Instead of focusing on one fixed period, the game follows a broad timeline where your settlement changes as time passes. As a result, each session is built around growth, planning, and steady progress. Players looking for the Pop Epoch latest version can expect a game centered on leading people, expanding power, and watching history move forward in a compact mobile format.


Build Through the Ages

Guide a tribe from its first settlement

Pop Epoch starts with a small tribe in a simple world, then asks you to shape its direction across different epochs. You act as the leader who decides how the civilization should grow. Over time, the setting moves from primitive conditions toward more developed stages, which gives the game its main sense of progress.

Manage growth and production

You build and improve the parts of your civilization that support expansion. Pop Epoch uses tycoon style growth, so production and resources matter throughout the game. As your settlement becomes larger, you need to keep development moving while making choices that support the next stage of progress.

Research technologies for progress

You use research to move your civilization beyond its current limits. Technology progression helps connect one era to the next, so every new milestone has a clear place in the wider timeline. This gives the game a steady rhythm, because advancement depends on more than only building more structures.

Meet historical figures

Pop Epoch includes legendary characters such as Archimedes, Shakespeare, Joan of Arc, and Socrates. These figures are tied to the theme of building a civilization across history. Their skills and knowledge can support your society, which adds another layer to the way you plan development and handle challenges.

Command forces in conflict

You can train infantry, cavalry, and other forces to protect your territory. Military strength matters when rivals appear or when you need to secure control. Because the game combines growth with conflict, you need to think about both development and defense as your civilization becomes stronger.


Pop Epoch Civilization Tycoon Details

Pop Epoch Civilization Tycoon is built around the idea of seeing history change in a short mobile session. The appeal comes from watching a basic tribe become a more advanced society without needing a slow, traditional strategy format. This makes the game easier to approach for players who like civilization themes but prefer faster progress.

The game also suits players who enjoy collecting important figures from history and using them as part of a broader plan. Since these characters are connected to wisdom, invention, leadership, and culture, they help give each stage of development a clearer identity. This supports the fantasy of acting as both a chieftain and an architect of history.


Pop Epoch Community and Official Site

Players who want official information can visit the Pop Epoch website from Nex Wave Games. Community spaces such as Facebook and Discord may also be useful for updates, events, and player interaction when available through official channels. These sources can help users follow the game outside normal play without changing the core download decision.

Official information:

  • Website: https://popepoch.nex-wave-tech.com/


How to Play Pop Epoch on Android

After you download Pop Epoch, start by following the early growth path and paying attention to what your civilization needs next. The game works best when you treat each action as part of a longer timeline, from basic survival to future development.

  1. Open the game and begin with the starting tribe, then follow the first prompts to understand your role as the leader.
  2. Build the early parts of your settlement so your people can produce resources and support further expansion.
  3. Use available resources to improve your civilization, then continue developing industry as new stages become available.
  4. Research technologies when possible, because new progress depends on moving from one epoch toward the next.
  5. Train troops and use heroes when conflict appears, then balance defense with continued development so your civilization keeps growing.


Get Started With Pop Epoch

Pop Epoch combines civilization growth, resource planning, technology research, historical heroes, and army command in one Android strategy game. If you want a mobile game about guiding society from early origins toward future eras, the Pop Epoch APK provides a direct way to begin playing.

description:
Put a finger on the screen and a 660cc turbo kei car wakes up. Slide over to a 4-rotor, a W16 or a racing V10 that screams to 19,000 rpm: 28 engines in all, each one synthesized live from how hard you press.

Start one on the train, in a waiting room or on the sofa, with no car anywhere near you.

ENGINES AND SOUND

- 28 engines: single, V-twin, two 660cc kei turbos, inline-4, inline-5, inline-6, a diesel truck inline-6, boxer-4, flat-6, V6, three V8s, V10, V12, W16, rotaries from 2-rotor to 4-rotor, and a racing V10 to 19,000 rpm

- Every sound is made live, not a recording on loop, so the same rev never sounds exactly the same twice

- The throttle follows your finger pressure: rest it for a soft idle, floor it for a full scream

- Per-cylinder firing, uneven exhaust timing and pipe resonance

- Haptics follow revs, load and shifts. Colour RPM gauge with rev-limiter cut

DRIVE IT YOURSELF

- H-pattern shifter or paddles, switch any time

- A clutch pedal with a real bite point: let it out too fast and the engine stalls

- Practice rev-matching: brake, blip, shift. Nail it and it's silent; botch it and the driveline thumps

- Straight-pipe mode for pops and bangs on lift-off, and a back turbine for compressor surge

TUNE AND SHARE

- Tune each engine with mufflers, intakes, headers, superchargers, cams and ECU maps, and watch 0–100 km/h (0–62 mph), top speed and the torque curve change on the spot

- Chassis tuning shared by every engine (weight, aero, flywheel), plus race clutch, race flywheel, carbon body and race aero

- Share a run as a video with the engine sound, or as audio only

REASONS TO KEEP DRIVING

- Miles from driving unlock engines and parts in the unlock tree, and garage miles keep building while the app is closed

- A Pit Stop summary after each drive (distance, miles earned, personal bests), daily tasks, a login bonus, weekly challenges and a trophy exchange

- A Parts Crate with the odds shown in the app, and invite codes that earn bonus miles

WHO IT'S FOR

- People who love engine and exhaust sounds

- Anyone curious how a V12 or a rotary sounds without owning one

- Drivers who want to practice the clutch and rev-matching before getting behind the wheel

AVAILABILITY

You start with the inline-4 and every core feature, with no ads on the driving screen. Driving earns miles that unlock the remaining engines and parts through the unlock tree. The next unowned V6, V8 or V12 can be rented for 10 minutes after a short video ad, and straight-pipe mode can be tried for 7 minutes the same way. Engines and parts can also be bought with an optional one-time in-app purchase. A one-time purchase removes the full-screen ads shown between engine switches; rentals and mile rewards stay available either way. No subscriptions.

Tip: headphones bring out the fine detail in every sound.

This simulator will give you a realistic experience of what it's like to handle a large ship. It includes some features which often seem to be missing in other simulators:

- Astern effect of the propeller

- Drift during turn

- Pivot point movement

- Rudder effectiveness based on propeller flow and ship's own velocity

- Bow thruster effectiveness influenced by ship's velocity

The game is played in a sandbox style with a sea, river and port environment and customisable current and wind effect.

The simulation is based on the mathematical hydrodynamic MMG model which is also used in professional ship handling and mooring simulators.

description:
Built by a 16-year air traffic controller. No ads. No coins. No accounts. Just the tower.

The developer spent 16 years working air traffic control and held four different FAA Control Tower Operator (CTO) licenses over his career. Control Tower 3D is that job, done honestly: you take the Local Control position, look out the cab window, and work the runway the way a real tower controller does — sequence the arrivals, launch the departures, and above all, keep them separated. Separation rules follow FAA Order JO 7110.65.

WORK THE POSITION

• SCAN THE RUNWAY. Sweep the full length before every clearance — a good scan earns the bonus and keeps you clear of incursions.

• SEQUENCE THE ARRIVALS. Clear them to land in order — number one, number two, number three — with proper spacing on final.

• WORK THE PATTERN. Extend upwind, extend downwind, turn base. Mix VFR pattern traffic with IFR arrivals, just like a real tower.

• RUN THE OPTIONS. Cleared for the option: low approach, touch-and-go, or stop-and-go.

• LAUNCH DEPARTURES. They taxi to the hold-short line on their own — get them airborne before the next arrival crosses the threshold, or it's a separation bust.

• HEAR THE RADIO. Pilots call up, read back clearances, and report the pattern with real text-to-speech voices.

• DON'T LET THEM MEET. Two aircraft in the same place is a very bad day.

NEW IN THIS UPDATE

• Today's Shift — one 8-minute shift a day with the same traffic and weather for every controller in the world. Work it daily and build your streak.

• Guided first shift — your first launch walks you through arrivals, departures, sequencing and the go-around, one clearance at a time. No manual needed.

• Now in Spanish, Portuguese, German, Hindi and Arabic — the game follows your phone's language.

• Real tower photography on the menu and the new icon.

MODES

• Easy, Normal and Rush shifts — timed, graded A+ to F.

• Levels campaign — 8 levels: timed warm-ups, then clear 25 to 150 operations as traffic builds.

• Today's Shift with a daily streak, My Top 100 kept on your device, and a Shared Top 10 you can join with a nickname.

• Save and resume mid-shift. Day, dusk and night settings, dynamic weather with approach lighting.

Whether you search for airport games, plane landing games, flight control, radar games, aviation sims, ATC games or an air traffic control tower simulator — this is the tower, and the position is yours. Fully offline, no account, no ads, free.

A DJ's Puzzle Palace game.
whats_new: Career mode: earn XP and pass checkrides to rise from Trainee to Chief Controller. New second airport, Kaigan Point Air Station, unlocked at Senior Controller. Levels 9-12 with wind shifts and emergencies. Tower radar scope, zoom, and pilot voices. Veterans Day livery Nov 7-15. Players in Europe and the UK can change their ad privacy choices from the menu.

A kitten is left at your shelter door. No name tag, no note.

The only clue is the face — a folded ear, one blue eye, a paw with an extra toe.

Read the parents in the kitten's face, then search the town to find them.

▪ A face never lies

Coat color, pattern, eyes, ears, tail, toes — every cat in this town is born by real genetic rules. Why two black parents can have a calico, why odd eyes show up in only one of the litter: it is all in the game. One recessive trait in the kitten is proof that a parent is hiding it.

▪ Search the town

Parking lot, market, park, alley, riverside, abandoned factory. Each place has its own cats, and day and night bring out different ones. Sneak up and scoop a cat into your arms, lure one with food, or set a trap and come back later. Shy cats hide — catch their eyes and look under things to find them.

▪ Decide only when you are sure

Observe the candidates you brought home, confirm their traits one by one, and name the father and the mother separately on the elimination board. Guessing will not get you through.

▪ Run the shelter

Food and water, litter boxes, the right toy for each cat, wand play, brushing and lasers. Place the furniture wherever you like. As trust grows, cats greet you first, bring you gifts and show their own little habits. Well-cared-for cats are adopted by good families, and letters arrive later. Take photos for the album and fill your family book and family tree.

▪ What this game does not do

· No gacha. Cats are met, not rolled.

· Cats in your shelter never die.

· No pop-up interstitial ads. Rewarded ads play only when you tap the button.

· Nothing is sold to undo a failed case.

▪ Good to know

· Sign in (Apple or Google) to keep your progress and purchases on your account across devices. Without signing in, everything stays on this device.

· Portrait, one-handed play. A full loop takes 5-10 minutes.

· Korean, English, Japanese, Chinese (Simplified/Traditional) and Spanish.

description:
Dive into a world of strategy and construction where every decision shapes your production network and the cities that depend on it!

Build factories, power plants, and purification stations, connect them with roads, and keep your resources in balance. Your goal is to produce goods, grow cities, and create efficient supply chains — all while keeping the environment clean. Each level brings new challenges and opportunities.

Basic buildings form the foundation of your economy. Mines extract stone, coal, ore, and oil, while sawmills produce wood. They only require energy and serve as the starting point for creating more advanced materials.

Factories are the heart of your production. They turn raw resources into refined materials — but be careful: factories consume energy, produce emissions, and demand careful planning.

Power plants supply energy to all your buildings. From coal plants to wind turbines, each type has its own cost and environmental impact. If consumption exceeds production, you’ll face an energy crisis!

Purification plants are your allies against pollution. They process emissions from factories and power plants — some even generate useful byproducts — but they also require energy. Keep pollution under control to prevent your cities from degrading.

Warehouses serve as logistics hubs. They store resources and help optimize delivery routes.

A key mechanic is city development. Each city offers unique trade deals — exchange resources for coins, upgrade cities to unlock new buildings, recipes, and materials. Higher-level cities demand more complex resources, but the rewards grow with them.

Connect every part of your infrastructure with three types of roads: dirt, city, and highway. Plan routes and expand your logistics network to keep production flowing smoothly.

Every new game generates a unique map full of resources and obstacles to navigate and exploit. Develop your industries, build supply chains, and watch your cities evolve into thriving metropolises!

description:
What happens when you offer an anomaly an ordinary object? And when echoes from the ocean floor begin to answer? Enter SCP: Containment Lab and find out.

Run two secret facilities in a 2D incremental game of experiments, surveillance and unsettling discoveries. Explore 92 SCPs: 60 at the land facility and 32 at the underwater site. Travel between laboratories on the world map, descend through five land sectors and reach three levels in the ocean depths.

DESCEND TO THE ABYSSAL STATION

From the platform to the deep station and abyssal core, each underwater level has its own architecture, lighting, music and tension. Pressure rises, power fails and machinery struggles to keep running. Investigate marine anomalies with distinctive profiles and reactions.

EXPERIMENT UNDER PRESSURE

At the underwater site, test samples with pressure, liquid immersion, electromagnetic fields, radiation and spectral analysis. Watch mechanical arms, tanks and instruments carry out each procedure. Compare responses, uncover special behavior and keep your reports in the archive.

LISTEN TO WHAT IS OUTSIDE

Open external monitoring and follow sonar echoes. Switch between radar and hydrophone channels, track contacts and investigate signals that should not be there. Some anomalies can only be discovered outside the facility.

MONITOR LAND CONTAINMENT

Meet SCP-999, SCP-173, SCP-049, SCP-096 and other anomalies. Watch interactive camera scenes, record rare events and look for silent secrets. Offer supplies at the object bench and see whether an SCP accepts, ignores, destroys or returns something transformed. Experiment with light, darkness, ultraviolet, infrared, heat and cold.

OPERATE, STUDY AND EXPAND

Complete interactive protocols, capture anomalous readings and gather data and research. Invest in upgrades, complete goals and advance through increasingly unstable sectors. Collect dossiers, observations, recordings and experiment results. Return to collect up to eight hours of offline production.

A WORLD TO WATCH AND HEAR

Cameras, containment listening, machinery, environments and events give the anomalies their own character. Optional sound and motion experiments use your device's microphone and movement sensors where supported. Quiet observation can reveal something too.

Adaptive layouts support phones, tablets, Chromebooks and Google Play Games on PC. Menus, dossiers and written records support English, Brazilian Portuguese, Latin American Spanish, Simplified Chinese, Hindi, Arabic, French, Bengali, Russian and Indonesian. Recorded voices preserve the language of the recording itself.

The first land sector and first underwater level are free. A single, permanent Full Access purchase unlocks the six remaining sectors and their 68 additional SCPs across both sites. No ads or credit packs. Restore your purchase with the same Google Play account. Progress is stored on your device; uninstalling removes local progress.

An independent adaptation of the SCP Foundation, released under CC BY-SA 3.0. Not officially affiliated with the SCP Wiki or its authors. Original articles, authors, sources and licenses are credited inside the game. Experiments, illustrations and records include creative adaptations of the source material.

Secure. Contain. Protect.

Investigate the ocean with sonar and hydrophones, and test samples with pressure, liquids, electromagnetic fields, radiation and spectral analysis. description:
FREE. All five original stories — every act, every ending — are now completely free. No ads, no subscriptions. One optional one-time purchase unlocks the new final story, THE ACCOUNT.

A nation has been written into existence overnight. The bahi-khata ledgers of every household are open to a blank page. Yours has forty rupees in it, and a single torn entry your father left behind.

THE LEDGER REPORT is a turn-based narrative strategy game about the stock market, trade, and family fortune in post-Independence India, told through five interwoven lives between 1947 and 1965 — and, in the finale, the 1966 inquiry that weighs them all. There is no levelling up, no energy timers, no pay-to-win. Every turn is a paragraph you read and a choice you make, and every choice moves the three numbers that decide who you will have been by the time the ledger closes.

▸ FIVE PROTAGONISTS, FIVE LEDGERS — ALL FREE

Arjun, a broker's son in Bombay who walks back into the room that broke his father. Leela, a Cochin auditor's daughter who can read a balance sheet faster than she can read a face. Rahim, a Kashmiri customs clerk who knows what every crate at the Banihal Pass really contains. Amrita, a Jodhpur heiress whose grandmother left her a second ledger nobody else knows about. Wansuk, a Khasi-hills khadduh whose people's commons are about to be priced.

Five starting decks. Five worlds. None of them ends the same way.

▸ THE ACCOUNT — THE FINAL STORY

Bombay, 1966. Inspector Imtiaz Sayeed is handed the file everyone else refused to open: the Bhandari empire. Finish the five stories and the finale reads YOUR endings — the witnesses remember what your Arjun did, what your Leela buried, what your Wansuk refused. Thousands of combinations, one commission of inquiry, five ways it can end. The finale is the game's single one-time purchase — buy once, own it forever.

▸ HISTORY THAT BITES, NOT SCROLLS

Gandhi's assassination in 1948. The 1949 rupee devaluation. The Korean War commodities boom. The 1956 Companies Act. The Bonus Shares bull market of 1957. The 1962 war with China. The 1965 war with Pakistan. Historical events fire mid-campaign and rewrite your ledger in ways you cannot anticipate.

▸ CHOICES ARE PERMANENT

There is no save scumming. There is no rewind. Once you choose, the bahi-khata page closes and the next one opens. The game will not let you escape a story you wrote.

▸ THE TRUTH STAT

Two of your stats are visible — Capital and Reputation. A third, Truth, stays hidden until you have seen enough. Crossing the threshold rewrites how the game shows you the world. Some endings only exist on the other side of that line.

▸ AN OIL-PAINTED WORLD

Hand-painted backdrops in an oil-on-canvas style, historical event vignettes, and a cast of protagonists, witnesses and rivals — each with a painted face of their own, and a unique painting for every ending you reach.

▸ A PLAYTIME THAT ENDS

A full run with one protagonist is 90 minutes to 2 hours. All five is a weekend, and the finale is one long evening in 1966. The game is finite by design — when the inspector's ledger closes, you have seen the whole picture, and the second playthrough is on you.

▸ NO ACCOUNT, NO ADS

The game lives on your device — no login wall, no cloud save, no ads, no subscriptions. We collect anonymous gameplay statistics (such as which acts players reach) to improve the story — never your identity, contacts, or location. Settings → erase all data honours your right to be forgotten in a single tap.

A young nation. Five lives. One ledger — and one man who reads it.

Find the shortages.

Own the future.

Pay the price.

description:
A mechanics and driving simulator: you build your car's engine part by part, hear it run, then drive it in 3D on open roads and race tracks.

It's not just a racing game. It's where you find out why an engine works, and why it breaks.

▬ BUILD IT

16 layouts: single-cylinder, inline, V, VR, W, boxer, Wankel, H, U, X, radial, rotary radial, opposed-piston, triangular opposed-piston, articulated rotor and vane rotor. Up to 28 cylinders, four-stroke, two-stroke or Stirling. Plus steam, a jet engine, electric and hybrid.

Set bore and stroke to a tenth of a millimeter, then the valves, cams, exhaust, crank timing and rev limiter. 13 forced-induction setups, from a single turbo to superchargers and turbo-compound. Mean piston speed is shown in m/s: past 25, only a race engine holds together.

BUILD AN ENGINE goes further: you pick every part, the game works out the power, and the weakest part fails first. ENGINE SWAP draws five engines at random for your car.

▬ HEAR IT, MEASURE IT

Engine sound is calculated from the mechanics: cylinder count, firing order, exhaust, turbo. An animated cutaway shows pistons, rods and valves moving at true engine speed, and the torque and horsepower curves follow every change.

The roller DYNO measures your real power curve at full throttle. ENGINE MAP is ECU tuning: timing, mixture, boost, launch control, anti-lag. Switch off the safeguards and the engine can let go.

▬ AND IT BREAKS

Over-rev and a valve snaps. Turbos wear out, bad shifts kill the clutch, and exhaust gas that runs too hot melts a piston.

Oil ages, and sugar in the tank clogs the filter. The smoke tells you what's wrong: blue for oil, white for coolant, black when it runs rich.

Catalytic converter, particulate filter and EGR are fitted according to the model year, and the cat can melt. Crashes leave their mark: crumpled panels, wheels torn off.

▬ THEN YOU DRIVE IT

Interior, hood or exterior view. 21 gearboxes: stick shift with a clutch pedal, automatic, dual-clutch, sequential, CVT, truck splitter…

With realistic physics, the body dives under braking, squats under power and rolls in corners, and a truck turns in more slowly than a city car. With a gamepad or tilt steering, on race tracks and in GRAND TOUR, catching a sliding rear-drive car is up to you.

Steer by touch, by tilting the phone, with a gamepad (15 assignable controls, rumble) or with a keyboard on PC, in portrait or landscape.

Sun, rain or thunderstorms, from −20 to 45 °C. Night falls for real, and in a pre-2010 vehicle, switching on the headlights is your job.

▬ WHERE TO DRIVE

GRAND TOUR: a 100 km² country to explore by road, ringed by a highway with toll booths and tunnels. Inside: towns with roundabouts, the sea, a snowy mountain, a mountain pass, a kart track and a dirt autocross.

30 circuits: the Speedway, 14 race tracks and 15 road circuits with live traffic. Five endless roads, including a three-lane highway and a mountain descent. Up to five opponents, police with speed cameras, and a 12-point driving license.

▬ 1,803 VEHICLES

92 fictional makes and 502 model lines from 1896 to 2026: cars, motorcycles, quads, trucks, buses, tractors, tanks and stand-up scooters, from under 1 hp to 10,850 hp. A workshop to fit parts, a garage to keep your rides. Trailers and caravans hitch up, and you feel them.

▬ WHAT THE GAME DOESN'T DO

No account, no game server: it plays offline. Your vehicles and engines stay on your phone, and can be exported to a file.

The game itself sends nothing. Ads are served by Google, which uses your device's advertising ID (with your consent where required). They only show when you open a menu, no more than once every three minutes. A one-time purchase removes them.

▬ LANGUAGES

English, French, German, Spanish, Italian. Metric or imperial units.

All makes, model lines and names are fictional. The game is not affiliated with any manufacturer.

description:
Out of eight billion people, whose life will you live this time?

1 in 8 Billion is an offline card game that follows a life from birth to its last memories. Small decisions shape your health, happiness, relationships and money—and the story you leave behind.

A beginning you did not choose

Start a new life in one of 220 countries and territories. Meet your family and the people around you, find your way through school and work, and discover the place you call home.

Two choices, many possible lives

Swipe a card to choose your next step. There is room for kindness and ordinary pleasures, but luck, loss and difficult decisions can change your plans. Read what follows and see where your choices take you.

What remains at the end

Look back on the moments that mattered, then answer one last question. Keep a life card in your collection and save it as an image. Export your full record as an illustrated HTML book or a text file. Another life offers another beginning.

At your own pace

Random lives are free to play offline without signing up. Your progress and records stay on your device. The app uses the internet to check versions; once an update is confirmed as required, you must install it to keep playing.

Your own beginning and the shop

Random lives remain free. Spend 10 gems to choose a name, gender, country and four starting stats. Keep your chosen country and use the dice to randomize the rest. If you need gems, you can choose to watch a rewarded ad or buy a gem pack.

Ads and accounts

A full-screen ad may appear between completed lives, and a banner may appear in a separate area at the bottom, away from cards and controls. The optional one-time ad-removal purchase removes full-screen and banner ads; optional rewarded ads remain available. Prices are shown by the store. Accounts, gems, ads, purchases and restoration require internet access. You can buy ad removal and gems without linking a game account, and restore ad removal using the same store account. Linking a game account is optional; link the same game account on another device to access the same gem balance. Game progress and records stay on your device and are not synced to your account.

Optional usage statistics

Sharing usage statistics to improve the app is off by default. You can turn it on or off in Settings. When enabled, usage statistics are sent over the internet. You can play without sharing them.

About the stories

Characters and events are fictional. Real countries, territories and selected statistics provide context, not predictions about anyone's future. Random starting locations are weighted by the population of the supported countries and territories; this is not a model of actual birth probabilities.

Stories include illness, accidents, bereavement, crime and fictional lottery play. Nothing is posted online automatically. Export any memories you want to keep before deleting the app or changing devices.

In addition, its theme focuses on planting flowers, collecting cute items, and shaping a garden at your own pace. Players looking to download Thế Giới Hoa Viên Của Tôi can expect a light garden routine built around flowers, decoration, and social play.


Main Features

Grow flowers through a simple garden cycle

Thế Giới Hoa Viên Của Tôi uses a familiar farming flow where you plant seeds, water them, wait for growth, and harvest flowers. After that, you can sell flowers to customers and use progress to expand the garden. This feature gives the flower growing loop a more practical purpose, while still keeping the gameplay centered on planting and garden care.

Decorate a personal flower garden

You can use many flower types and decoration items to shape the garden in your own style. The available flowers include varieties linked to Vietnam, which gives the garden a local feeling for players familiar with those plants. As the garden grows, decoration becomes part of the main experience rather than a separate side activity.

Relax with gentle visuals and sound

Thế Giới Hoa Viên Của Tôi presents its garden through cartoon style visuals, nature sounds, and ASMR inspired audio. These elements support a slow play rhythm, so the game suits users who prefer low pressure activities after a long day. Instead of fast reactions, the game focuses on regular care, collecting, and arranging the garden space.

Visit friends and join community activities

You can interact with other players through guilds, leaderboards, friend visits, and neighbor garden actions. The game also includes the playful option to take flowers from nearby gardens, which adds a social layer to the farming loop. Alongside this, pet cats can help with flower care, accompany the player, and bring back surprise gifts from adventures.


Things to Know About Thế Giới Hoa Viên Của Tôi

Thế Giới Hoa Viên Của Tôi is most suitable for players who like slow progress, garden decoration, cute collecting, and farming tasks. It may not be the right choice for users who want action based battles or complex strategy systems. Before installing Thế Giới Hoa Viên Của Tôi APK, it is helpful to understand that the main satisfaction comes from repeated planting, harvesting, collecting items, and gradually improving the garden.


Codes and New Player Gifts in Thế Giới Hoa Viên Của Tôi

Many players search for code Thế Giới Hoa Viên Của Tôi because reward codes can be linked to items such as rare seeds, beginner gifts, or limited outfits when available. The provided game information does not list active codes, so users should check the app page and official in game notices for current rewards. This is useful for new players who want to start with extra resources without changing the normal garden routine.


How to Play Thế Giới Hoa Viên Của Tôi on Android

Thế Giới Hoa Viên Của Tôi is built around short garden sessions that can be repeated throughout the day. After installing Thế Giới Hoa Viên Của Tôi latest version, players can follow the early garden flow and learn each system step by step.

  2. Choose available seeds, plant them in open plots, then water the flowers when the game asks for care.

description:
Caser is a case opening simulator for anyone who loves opening cases and chasing rare drops, with no real money involved.

WHAT'S INSIDE

• Cases from cheap to top-tier. Every case shows its full contents before you open it: every item and its exact drop chance.

• A free case for watching an ad. It opens with any balance, so you're never stuck if you run out.

• Open in bulk: one, two, three, five or ten cases at once, with a summary for the whole batch.

• Upgrade: put up an item, pick a pricier target and spin the wheel. The pricier the target, the lower the chance, and that chance is shown right on the wheel. The whole catalogue of over 4,400 items takes part.

• Case Battles: everyone opens the same case at the same time, and whoever gets the highest total takes every drop. Your opponents are bots, so it works offline, no other players needed.

• Inventory sorted by price or by date, with selling one by one or all at once.

• A feed of recent drops, profile statistics and your best item of all time.

FAIR ODDS

The odds aren't hidden in the rules or buried in fine print. A case's contents open with one tap, every item shows its chance, and the upgrade wheel shows the chance of the target you picked. Nothing is recalculated behind your back.

IMPORTANT

This is a simulator. The balance, the items and every number in the game are fictional. Real money is not accepted, not paid out and not won. Items can't be bought for money, sold, traded or taken outside the app. There are no in-app purchases.

Intended for adults.

ADS

The app is free and supported by ads. A video plays only when you tap the free case button yourself. A full-screen ad appears no more than once per session and never before your fifth case, and you're warned before it shows.

description:
Live a whole Nigerian life in 3D. Naija Life is a life simulator set in Nigeria, where six meters keep you alive: hunger, energy, fun, social, hygiene and bladder. They fall on their own. Money comes from work, gigs and the occasional bad idea. Everything costs in-game minutes, and the day only has so many of them.

Start in Lagos and then live across the country: Lagos, Abuja and Port Harcourt are all on the map, each with its own streets, homes, venues and prices. Fly or take the road between them and keep a place in any of them.

THREE CITIES, ONE LIFE

• Lagos — ride danfo, hustle in Mushin, grind in Yaba, party on the Island

• Abuja Life — the capital, with its own districts, jobs and slower pace

• PH Life — Port Harcourt, the garden city: oil money, river views and its own scene

• Move between all three by road or by air, and set up home wherever you land

WHAT YOU CAN DO

• 125 places across three cities — Amala Shitta, Quilox, Balogun market and Elegushi beach in Lagos; Aso Rock, Wuse Market and Jabi Lake in Abuja; Mile One Market and Kidney Island in Port Harcourt

• 25 careers with five levels each — tech intern to CTO, backup singer to Afrobeats giant, cadet to chief pilot, graduate trainee to petroleum technical director

• 17 homes, from a face-me-I-face-you in Mushin to a Banana Island mansion — rent them, or save up and buy them outright so the rent stops for good

• Garages for your cars, luxury pieces, household staff, and 85 pieces of furniture with Ankara and Adire wallpaper to decorate with

• Six needs, nine skills and 659 actions — every one with its own duration, cost and effect

• Haggle at the market stall: "Oga, last price nko?"

• Danfo, keke, okada, cab or your own car around town; flights and the night bus between cities

• A weekly governor's race with candidates, policies, a ballot and a live count that changes fares, pay and prices

• NEPA, generators and fuel scarcity — the light is never guaranteed

• Seven Naija radio stations playing as you move around the city

• A daily gift that grows every day you come back

• 144 moodlets, ten traits, five aspirations, twenty-two wishes and fourteen reward perks

CREATE YOUR LAGOSIAN

Braids, locs or a gele; an Ankara, Adire or Aso-oke fit for the owambe; seven skin tones and a trait that decides how you handle the city — Hustler, Foodie, Owambe Spirit, Smooth Talker, Night Crawler and more.

PUT YOUR BUSINESS ON THE MAP

Spend the naira you earn on a banner on one of 64 billboards over the roads, or a plot on the Lagos lagoon or the land in Abuja and PH. Add your picture and your link, and every player who taps it can visit you — a real advert, seen by real players.

THE CITY ANSWERS BACK

Hustle on a shift, chase a promotion, take a gig, sell what you made and buy what you need. Sneak into the VIP section or square up to an agbero, and if you are caught it is a fine, or a night in the cell at Eko Police Division.

FRIENDS, NOT JUST NPCs

Sign in to chat with other players in real time, send DMs, send money to friends, form a squad and climb the Rich List. Or play as a guest: device-local save, no chat, the whole city to yourself.

YOUR SAVE IS SAFE

Your save is kept in the cloud, so your progress follows you between your phone and your browser.

Naija Life is developed and published by GreatCallie International Ltd. It is not affiliated with any other app, game or website.

description:

Waiting for you are the Angels: four dangerously handsome bodyguards who protected you from the shadows when you were a teenager, and who have just been ordered back into your life to keep you alive.

You barely remember them. They remember everything about you.

A rival family is moving against yours. Your father is hiding something. And the four men sworn to protect you are the four men you were never supposed to want.

Every conversation is a choice. Every choice is remembered.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

MEET THE ANGELS

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

🎯 CILLIAN — The mysterious sniper with secrets behind his eyes. He watches everything, says almost nothing, and would step between you and a bullet without blinking.

💪 WYATT — The powerful mechanic with a protective heart. Rough hands, blunt words, and the only one who tells you the truth even when it hurts.

💻 MATTEO — The tender tech genius who sees straight through your walls. He knows every secret this family keeps — including yours.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

YOUR STORY, YOUR CHOICE

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

💕 CHOOSE YOUR ROMANCE — All four routes are open from the start. Follow one man to the end, or take your time and let them earn you.

🔥 SHAPE THE STORY — Every choice changes how they see you, what they trust you with, and how your story ends. There is no single right path.

💬 CHAT WITH THEM — The story doesn't stop when the chapter does. Private messages, late-night confessions, conversations that belong only to you and him.

🎭 CREATE YOUR HEROINE — Choose her look and make her yours.

🌃 EXPLORE THEIR WORLD — From Boston backstreets to safe houses, penthouses and the family's luxury villas.

👗 DRESS THE PART — Outfits for every scene, from a quiet morning to a night nobody forgets.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

THE STORY DOESN'T END THERE

Finish the main story and keep going. Luca and Wyatt each have their own full second season — dozens of chapters that take you where the main plot never could. And new stories keep arriving, with faces this family would rather you never met.

You don't have to pick just one. You just have to live with who you picked.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

HOW IT PLAYS

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

description:
Traffic Flow is a clean, hypnotic idle game about one thing: moving people into seats.

Passengers arrive as a glowing queue. They check in at the gate, walk the path, step through the door and take a seat. Every seat that fills pays you. Fill the whole vehicle and it departs, then the next one rolls in and the queue starts again.

YOUR JOB IS THE BOTTLENECK

You never drive anything. You find whatever is slowing the line down and you fix it. Three upgrade tracks, thirty levels each:

GATE. Faster check in, instant check in, and higher check in income.

TRANSIT. Faster walking, faster boarding, and income at the door.

SEATING. Faster seating, instant seating, and higher income per seat.

Push one track and the queue backs up somewhere else. Balancing all three is the whole game.

FROM ONE SMALL PLANE TO A GLOBAL NETWORK

You start with a short hop out of Dublin and a plane with a few dozen seats. Earn enough and you move up to a wide body jet where premium rows pay several times what economy does, then to entirely new kinds of transit:

Planes. Long routes, big cabins, premium seating up front.

Buses. Short hops that turn over fast.

Trains. Multiple cars filling at the same time.

Ships. Huge twin aisle decks and the longest passenger queues in the game.

Each vehicle type is opened by a one time certificate from the research screen, so every unlock is a real step change rather than another percentage.

ROUTES AND CITIES

The player hub is a route map for each vehicle type. Pick a city, see its seat count and its income ceiling, and switch your run to it. Dublin, Singapore, Cambridge, Brussels, Bilbao and more, each with a different mix of economy and premium seats.

NUMBERS THAT ACTUALLY GO UP

Your first plane earns a few hundred a minute. Late game ships earn billions a minute. The jump from hundreds to billions is the point, and you can watch every step of it happen on one screen.

BUILT TO BE CALM

No timers pressuring you, no lives, no fail state. Pure neon on black, a readable grid of seats, and a queue you can watch for as long as you like. Play with sound off. Play one handed. Put it down mid boarding and pick it up later.

description:
Your cats have jobs. Your tavern has customers. Somewhere in your pond, a rainbow fish is swimming around.

Catfinity is a cozy idle cat RPG. Adopt a colony of pixel cats, give every one of them a job, and let them work, cook, fish, farm and go adventuring, even while your phone is in your pocket.

You start with one Tabby and a single tap. Before long you are running a whole little world.

OPEN THE TAVERN

Put on an apron and start a shift. Diners fill the tables, each wanting something your pantry can make. Cook to order in the Kitty Kitchen and put your cats on the floor as server, bus cat and dishwasher. Some cats have a knack for a station and some are hopeless at it, so tap Auto party and let the tavern pick the best crew.

Earn renown and your Corner Pub grows through fifteen levels into the Heart of the Town, with plants, a rug and a painting settling in along the way. When the lanterns go out, tired cats curl up at the Inn and dream.

GIVE EVERY CAT A CALLING

Thirty jobs, from Rancher and Fishercat to Ninja, Necromancer and Pyromancer, each with its own hat and levels. Spin the Job Wheel to try a new one. Save a Colony Loadout of everyone's jobs, gear and mounts, and swap the whole colony in one tap when a different boss comes to town.

GO ON AN ADVENTURE

Build a balanced five-cat party of tank, healer, support and damage, read the real odds, and send them after loot. A failed run costs you time, never your cats.

• Take on a daily raid boss with stances and weaknesses

• Check the Watchtower for the week ahead and keep a Field Guide of every boss you have felled

• After your first Purrvana, chase a feather up the endless Scratching Post

• After a Cosmic Nap, hold the wall with the whole colony in the Long Night

GONE FISHIN'

Cast into a pixel pond stocked with 58 fish, from Sardine to Golden Koi, with rare chests, better rods and bait. Open the fishing gear box, sip a cold drink from Barnaby's soda counter, or send a little AutoFish robot out to fish while you do something else. Keep your favorites in the Aquarium and watch for the one extremely elusive Rainbow Shark.

COOK, GROW, RAISE

• Cook dishes in the Kitty Kitchen that give your cats real buffs for dungeons and raids

• Grow crops in the Gardens and carry them straight to the tavern

• Raise chickens, ducks, bees, pigs, sheep, cows, horses and more on the Ranch, and collect eggs, milk and honey

• Let grown-up animals carry a cat into battle

• Set a cat on an egg in the Hatchery and wait to see what hatches

FORGE AND COLLECT

Smelt ore into bars at the Blacksmith, temper your gear, and melt spare pieces together into something rarer. Brew enchantments, runes and Purrscriptions at the NekoMancer. Hunt for quirky trinkets and dress your own pixel avatar to match.

NAP YOUR WAY UP

The prestige ladder is built around the laziest thing a cat does. Take a nap, wake up stronger, then climb from naps to Cosmic Naps, Purrvana and Catfinity itself. Seasonal events like Meow-lloween bring pumpkin bosses, costumes and a Trick-or-Treat stall.

Monthly leaderboards reset for everyone at once, so a new colony is never racing a two-year-old one, and more than 500 achievements wait along the way.

QUESTIONS PEOPLE ASK

What kind of game is this?

An idle RPG, also called incremental or AFK. The numbers go up while you are away, and when you check back in there is a real RPG waiting: jobs, parties, gear, dungeons, a raid boss, a tavern and a pond.

Does it work offline?

Yes. Your colony keeps earning the whole time you are gone, and the game plays fine with no connection.

Is it free?

Free to play, and playable forever without paying. Purchases are optional: cosmetics, music, extra room for gardens, pastures and nests, and small boosts. There are no paywalls. Ads are optional and always rewarded.

Grab a cat. Take a nap. Reach Catfinity.

description:
You are eighteen, broke, and recording in a bedroom. What happens next is

one hundred energy a week and the decisions you make with it.

Rapstar Sim is a weekly turn-based rap career simulator. Every week you

choose:

write a track, boost it, upgrade the room, run a campaign, take a shift at

the record store, book a tour, or call in a feature. Then you press END WEEK

and read what the world did back.

THE MUSIC

Song rating runs across seven bands to 120, and it is capped by your build,

not your wallet. No amount of cash buys a hit in week two. Rating decides how

long a song earns; virality decides how fast it spreads. They are separate

numbers on purpose, and the best tracks need both.

THE WORLD

Forty rival artists live their own careers. They drift, they release, and

they collaborate with each other whether you are involved or not, so The 25

reshuffles for reasons you did not cause. Every artist tracks

respect toward you. Respect is what makes an A-lister answer, and it takes up

to 45% off their feature fee, so the cheapest way to a big guest verse is

years of work rather than a big cheque.

THE BUSINESS

Streams pay. So do shows, music videos, merch and a portfolio. Once you have

two million in the bank and a real studio you can launch your own label, sign

the artists who respect you most, and finally own your masters. Property is

the only thing in the game that raises your energy ceiling, which is why a

house is a decision and not a trophy.

THE REST OF YOUR LIFE

You can date, and the career that makes you worth dating is the career that

makes you impossible to date. A meter tells you the odds before you propose,

and the ring is paid for whichever way they answer. Marriage, children and

what a divorce costs are all in there too.

THE ENDING

There is no retirement. The career ends when you die, and how you lived

decides how likely that is and what takes you. Then the game keeps going: the

estate releases what is still in the vault into a hype spike two to three

times anything you saw alive, licenses the catalogue to films, and finally

reduces the whole run to one number on a scorecard.

- Completely offline. No account, no ads, no internet permission at all.

- No timers, no waiting. The week ends when you say it does.

- Every cover and every face is generated, so no two careers look alike.

Streaming, video and chart screens are original designs inspired by the real

thing. This game is not affiliated with any music service or publication.

Dinosaur Survival Game Simulator 3D sounds like one of those games where you really get into being a dinosaur. I mean, its for people who like animal simulators or survival stuff, and maybe hunting games too. You step into this prehistoric setup that's dangerous, and yeah, only the tough ones make it.

Playing as a wild dinosaur, you just roam around this big area with all kinds of problems popping up, like enemies or whatever chances you get. The game mixes action and exploring with surviving, so it feels pretty full when yours in it.

The realistic part hits you with how the controls work and the way things move around. Its an advanced simulator where the world is open and large, so you can go wherever without much stopping you.

Living as a dinosaur there, every move counts in this detailed universe they built. You hunt for stuff, look around, and try to stay alive, and the animal simulator side makes it immersive, I think.

Survival is what its all about, really. You have to learn these dinosaur skills to not die, like hunting animals or finding food, and watching out for dangers all the time. Then there are battles that get intense, like in a fighting game but with dinosaurs, and the Jurassic environment is full of risks.

On this island that's risky for survival, threats are just everywhere, so you explore different spots and adapt or fight to get stronger. It pushes you in every way, sort of.

Not just surviving alone, though. You can build a family of Dino and protect them, which adds this legacy thing. Its a family adventure where you grow your group and hunt together or defend your spot.

Exploring together feels real in the Dino family sim, and the animal simulator keeps it engaging.

The open world is massive, with forests and rivers, plus hidden places you stumble on. In this Jurassic setup, the forest adventure makes exploring key for staying alive, and it offers all these possibilities so each time is different.

I might be oversimplifying, but the universe is detailed enough that you don't run out of things to do quick.

Features wise, the graphics are high quality for a 3D dinosaur simulator. The environment is large and open, gameplay feels realistic for animals, and the hunting mechanics pull you in. Survival system is challenging, you manage your dino family, explore a dynamic Jurassic world, controls are smooth for the simulator, and it even works offline.

This game gives you the full dinosaur survival thing, whether yours into fighting as Dino , animal sims, or just surviving. You deal with tough conditions, hunt, explore the wild, and try to be the strongest in that 3D world.

It seems like it has everything packed in, so downloading it starts this epic journey.

This game recreates the excitement of 90s console games on modern smartphones, offering a "simple yet serious" professional baseball simulation game for adults.
