description:
WiseMan is a text-based mafia life simulator you can play offline. Part mafia boss simulator, part crime life simulator: rise from street kid to mob boss, or build an honest career. In this choice-driven roleplay game, a text RPG, every decision leaves a mark years later.

You are born with nothing — a name, a country, and a family you did not choose. From there, one year at a time, you decide who you become.

WiseMan is a life simulator. The street is one road, not the only one. You can stay in school and become a doctor. You can open a shop and turn it into a holding company. You can run for office. Or you can take the other door, and find out what it costs.

ONE CHOICE A YEAR

Every year hands you a card. A friend needs an alibi. Your father calls for money. A stranger offers you work you shouldn't take. There is no right answer — only the answer you can live with, and the years that follow it.

WHAT YOU CHOOSE COMES BACK

A choice is not a number. Take the blame for someone today and, six years from now, a door opens that was closed to everyone else. Look away, and someone remembers. The game keeps your record and reads it back to you.

THE INFLUENCE LADDER

Street, money, office and name — four pillars, one score, seven rungs, from Kid of the Block to Legend. The top rungs do not fit inside a single life: a dynasty needs a second generation, a legend a third.

TAKE THE CITY, DISTRICT BY DISTRICT

Join a crime family and the city opens up as a map: port, bazaar, casino street, industrial zone, suburbs. Each district asks for rank, respect, fear and a crew. Move in, station your men, collect tribute every 48 hours — and when a rival gang contests your turf, decide whether it's worth a war.

A WHOLE LIFE, NOT A MENU

Fall in love, marry, raise children, lose people. Study, work, get promoted, get fired. Buy a car, a shop, a house, a ship. Get sick, get old. Chronic illness does not go away — you manage it, and pay for it, for the rest of your life. Prison changes what people will do with you afterwards.

WHEN YOU DIE, IT ISN'T OVER

Your child inherits your name, your debts and your reputation. The Dynasty Book records the peak of every life — not the moment you died, but the highest you ever stood.

BORN ANYWHERE

Pick from over 250 countries and regions. Where you are born changes the names around you, the money in the house, the schools, the work, and the roads open to you.

22 LANGUAGES

Written for each language, not run through a translator.

If you like mafia games, gangster stories, crime simulators and text-based RPGs, WiseMan puts them all in one offline life: the family, the street, the money, the law and the choices you cannot take back.

Free to play. Optional purchases and rewarded ads; you can remove ads for good. No account, no sign-up. Your save lives on your phone and the game works offline.

description:
ATC Simulator 3D Voice Control is an air traffic control simulator where you work the radio with your own voice. You key the microphone and issue clearances in standard FAA phraseology, and pilots answer over a radio-filtered channel with full readbacks before they fly your instructions. You sit in the 3D tower cab looking out at the runways, or in the radar room working approach, or in the cockpit flying an aircraft yourself.

VOICE ON THE FREQUENCY

Press push-to-talk and speak the clearance: "Seacliff four zero one, descend and maintain five thousand, cleared ILS runway two five right." Pilots read the instruction back in distinct voices and execute it. If an instruction makes no sense they query it, and if you were unclear they ask you to say again. When you cannot talk, you can tap any aircraft and issue the same commands by touch.

THREE SEATS TO WORK

- Approach radar: vector arrivals from the terminal boundary onto the ILS with headings, altitudes and speeds. Hold traffic when the final fills up, clear aircraft for visual approaches, and hand each arrival off to the tower.

- 3D tower cab: watch the airport through the cab windows. Drag flight strips to set your departure sequence, taxi aircraft along named taxiways, issue hold short and runway crossing clearances, clear departures for takeoff and arrivals to land, and send a flight around when separation breaks down.

- Pilot in command: take the cockpit seat while the tower is worked for you. You fly airliner decks with working autopilot panels, a turboprop, a light single, or a fighter. You dial your cleared altitude, heading and speed, and make every radio call and readback yourself.

THE AIRPORTS AND THE FLEET

Work three fields:

- San Francisco International (KSFO), with two pairs of crossing parallel runways.

- Palo Alto Airport (KPAO), a general aviation field where you work tower and ground together and fit VFR callers into a busy pattern of flight school trainers.

- Bayview International, a training airport built for learning radar, tower and winter operations.

Over 25 aircraft types share the ramps and approaches, from the Cessna 172 and Dash 8 to the 737, A320, 777, A380, C-17 and F-16. Shifts start with full gates, moving jet bridges, and pushback tugs.

WEATHER, WINTER AND EMERGENCIES

Every shift begins with a weather and runway briefing. Rain runs down the cab glass and lengthens landing rolls. In fog, arrivals go around at minimums and divert. During winter operations at Bayview, pilots pass braking action reports, departures taxi through the de-icing pad, and you close runways for the snowploughs. When emergencies are enabled, a departure may strike birds on climb-out and turn back under a MAYDAY or PAN-PAN, and an arrival on final may declare smoke in the cockpit, an engine failure or a hydraulic failure. You clear the traffic path and roll the rescue equipment.

LEARN THE PHRASEOLOGY AND RULES

Phraseology follows FAA Order JO 7110.65. Your post-shift score sheet shows the rule behind each point, and the built-in handbook opens the FAA paragraph behind an instruction.

- Ground school: 18 chapters with voiced radio examples and a glossary.

- Guided lessons: 23 instructor-voiced lessons on the approach radar scope and in the tower cab.

- Radio School: 42 radio drills across 7 packs.

OFFLINE AND ONLINE PLAY

The simulation, weather, emergencies, scoring, lessons, handbook and pilot voices all work offline. Without a connection, voice control uses your phone's own speech recognizer if an offline English speech pack is installed, and touch commands always work. An internet connection adds the live world: cloud speech recognition for your clearances, and live, directed events in your shift.

No ads, and no account to create. Not affiliated with the FAA, and not for real-world training. Aircraft, manufacturer and airline names are trademarks of their owners, used only to identify them, and imply no affiliation or endorsement.

description:
Rally Dynasty is a rally management game by an independent developer, starting in 1973 and rolling on past today. You run one family team through five regulation eras — hiring drivers, building cars, managing exact money and real time — while heirs inherit the team when a driver retires or dies. It is unofficial and unlicensed, in the spirit of the classic World Rally Championship decades. Platforms: PC (web/Steam) and Android.

THE ROAD IS THE OPPONENT

You never touch the wheel. You choose the programme, the car, the crew and the tyres, and then you live with it. Pace is exact and stated in seconds. Danger is never a percentage — it is a sentence, because that is how it is actually known.

FIFTY-FOUR SEASONS, AND THE RULES CHANGE UNDER YOU

1973 opens with a championship for makes, not drivers. Group B arrives, and then it is banned. Central service parks end roadside repairs. Pace notes arrive at the RAC in 1990. Mousse tyres come and go. Every one of those changes is modelled from the record and dated, not averaged into a vague retro feel.

THE TEAM IS PEOPLE, AND PEOPLE AGE

Drivers improve with competitive kilometres and plateau at their potential. They peak, they decline, they get hurt, and sometimes they are killed — at the rate the era actually killed them. A dead driver's seat opens. The record stands.

ONE FAMILY, HALF A CENTURY

When the head of the team retires or dies, the dynasty passes to an heir or to a brother. The name on the entry list stays; the person behind it does not. A campaign is not a career — it is a lineage.

EXACT ON MONEY

Gearboxes cost £200,000 because they did. Entry fees, travel, freight, wages, sponsor retainers and prize money are all period figures, in period currency, and the ledger shows you every one of them.

BUILT FOR A PHONE

One tap runs a weekend. Take the season stage by stage if you want to feel it, or let it run itself and read the results. It works offline. There is no account and no sign-in, and the save never leaves your device.

PLAY IT YOUR WAY

Five interface languages. Light paper or the dark rally board. Reduced motion and colourblind presets.

WHAT IS OPEN, AND WHAT IS NOT

Two full careers — one starting in 1973, one starting in 2017 — and three seasons, at no cost. Nothing is held back and nothing is switched off; you simply run out of seasons. The rest of the century is one payment, once. There is no subscription, there are no adverts, and there is no in-game currency.

Historical team names and liveries include period sponsors, some of them tobacco and alcohol brands. They appear as they did on the cars.

Rally Dynasty is not associated with, endorsed by, or affiliated with the FIA or the WRC.

description:
Phroller, the next-gen VTT

Touchscreen native, controller tested, battery efficient, cross-platform, offline enabled, 2.5/3D VTT

Yup, you heard me. 

Move a token on your phone, see it move on your GM's laptop.

Roll a handful of dice on your iPad, see its results on your Steam Deck.

Platform:

Native software: Native compiled code allows for optimizations that web based VTTs can only dream of.

Touchscreen first development: Phroller was built for modern touch controls first. Use two fingers to resize/rotate images and control the camera. Better mouse, keyboard and controller support always in the works!

No account required: Quick Zoom/Jackbox styled session hosting and joining. All shared assets are shared between the users directly.

Offline prep: Phroller lives on your device. Images and Models saved to your collection are put into your own device storage and can be used without an internet connection!

Battery life without compromise: I spent weeks optimizing for battery life to make sure the platform stops overheating even through my longest DnD sessions.

Gameplay:

Collaborative GM-ing: Every user in a shared session could be given permissions to controls usually reserved for the GM. Ask your players to help draw a basic map, put decals on the board or even randomly place/control enemy tokens while you finalize stat blocks. You can do it at a real table, why not on a VTT? You can even share a revocable passcode with your players to give them full GM privileges!

Delightful Physics: More than just delightful dice rolling, you can throw your tokens across the map too!

Multi-level maps: easy to adjust level system lets you visualize and manage complex scenes featuring multiple elevations. With 3 different visualization modes depending on your needs [Side by side comparison of the three views]

Customize! You can customize the style of the vtt grid, the dice trays, the UI, the dice and even fill any of them with as much custom art as you want. Built in access to several massive libraries of art and symbols to personalize every part of the platform!

Smart Drag and Drop:

Images

in Decal Mode: Become maps and stickers

in Token Mode: Become paper mini/sticker tokens

in Prop Mode: Become 2.5D styled paper scenery pieces

3D Models

in Token Mode: Become 3D Tokens

in Prop Mode: Become unmovable props

PDFs: directly view them on the PDF board. With multi page pdf flipping

Yes, other players in a shared session see the page flip with you

Modular Tracking: Configurable widget layouts allow you to build and organize your own character/game managers the way you want. Current widgets available:

Sliders and Counters: Perfect for health and resource tracking

List and Tables: Great for attribute, skill, inventory and even turn order tracking!

Notes: With support for tabs and images

Drawings: You can doodle on the VTT too, but that’s shared with everybody. Why not also be able to doodle on your digital character manager? Also with tab support and image importing.

PDFs: Quick access to the various documents you’d want to have on hand.

And more!

Featuring asset libraries featuring thousands of art assets. Growing constantly! Want to see your models/art/maps/adventure/etc featured in Phroller? Please reach out to us!

Download Phroller today!

App Store Image Credits:

Maps by MapXilla, MapleMapsDnD, u/Asmind, Elven Tower Productions, and Angela Maps!

Imp model by GuZArt Commissions

Boat Model by Poly By Google

2D Token art by ZoeyTime Art

Additional credit info and artist links available in game

EULA: https://phroller.com/eula

◆ Heir to a Legendary Forge ◆

You are the descendant of a legendary blacksmith.

You've inherited a run-down forge — now it's time to make the kingdom know your name again.

① Strike the anvil to forge a sword

Forge with a timing mini-game. The better your strikes, the finer the blade!

The Crown grades your sword and sends you a hero of matching rank.

Offer a shoddy blade... and you may hear about it from the heroes.

The hero takes your sword and challenges the dungeon.

Monsters grow stronger with every floor — and something waits at the very bottom.

④ Read their letters

When the expedition ends, the hero sends back loot and a letter.

Sometimes thanks, sometimes complaints, sometimes... unexpected news.

◆ Features ◆

- Timing-based forging — every sword is struck by your own hand

- Countless combinations of sword rank × hero rank

- Collect them all: Sword Codex, Hero Codex, Letter Codex

- Grow your forge and build your Fame

The forge fire never goes out.

description:
Run your own restaurant, cook delicious food and build a food empire across a bright, busy city! Dine City: Restaurant Tycoon is a cozy cooking game and idle tycoon where you start with one small burger diner and grow it into 48 restaurants. Serve happy guests, hire a crew, upgrade every kitchen and become the most famous chef in town.

🍔 COOK, SERVE AND COLLECT

Grab fresh ingredients from the pantry, fire up the grill and cook juicy burgers, stone-oven pizza, sushi rolls, ramen, tacos, BBQ, pancakes and ice cream. Take orders at the register, serve each table, collect your coins and clean up for the next guest. Tap at the perfect moment while cooking for a bonus tip!

🏙️ 48 RESTAURANTS IN 8 DISTRICTS

Open restaurants from Downtown and Harborfront to the Night Market, the Garden District and Festival Island. Every district has its own look, and every restaurant has its own menu and kitchen stations.

🍣 FIVE KINDS OF RESTAURANTS

Classic diners, cozy cafes and bakeries, sushi and noodle bars with stools at the counter, family pizza halls with long tables, and BBQ yards with picnic benches. Halls grow bigger as you go, with more space for tables and guests.

👩‍🍳 HIRE YOUR DREAM TEAM

Hire a cashier, chef, waiter and cleaner, train them to work faster and let your restaurant run itself. Buy each new station, table, worker and the delivery service right on the floor: stand on the spot and pour in your coins.

🛵 DELIVERY ORDERS

Open the delivery rack, pack parcels for the courier and earn extra coins from orders across the city.

👑 VIP GUESTS AND BIG TIPS

Look out for VIP guests with golden crowns. Serve them fast for huge tips and keep your restaurant rating at five stars.

⬆️ UPGRADE EVERYTHING

Faster stations, new recipes, more tables, a bigger pantry, a faster chef and more hands to carry dishes. Every upgrade makes your restaurant busier and your income bigger.

🎁 DAILY REWARDS AND MISSIONS

Collect a daily reward with a 7-day streak, finish fresh daily missions, win trophies and climb 120 chef levels.

🗺️ YOUR CITY, YOUR EMPIRE

Explore the 3D city map, buy street food kiosks between districts and collect their earnings. Your restaurants keep earning a little while you are away.

📴 PLAY OFFLINE, ANYTIME

No account and no internet needed to play. Your restaurants are saved on your phone, so you can cook on the train, on a flight or on your coffee break.

❓ QUICK ANSWERS

Is Dine City free to play? Yes. It is free with optional rewarded videos and a few ads at natural breaks.

Can I play without internet? Yes, the whole game works offline.

Is it an idle game? Yes and no: you cook and serve yourself, then hire staff who keep working for you.

Is it good for all ages? Yes. It is a family-friendly restaurant simulator with no violence.

If you love cooking games, restaurant management, cafe games and idle tycoon simulators, Dine City is your new favourite kitchen. Put on your chef hat and open your first restaurant today!
